patches_added.name: Folders by chat type
patches_added.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Save downloaded files
patches_added.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Black and white launch logo
patches_added.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the app icon, on Android 13 and up. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches_added.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_added.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches_modified.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.
patches_modified.previous_description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Back leaves Home
patches_added.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_added.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_added.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches_added.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_added.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_added.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_added.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Long press to zoom
patches_added.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_added.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Accent color
patches_added.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_added.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_added.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches_added.description: Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo, saving the largest size Instagram sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster, and a download icon beside Save under each post. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover and a Details row with the post's time and poster. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Search, Create and Profile, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search button and a Ghost mode button to it, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Search, Create and Profile, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search button and a Ghost mode button to it, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets a double tap on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Keep playing in the background
patches_modified.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. Handy for music and talks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets a long press on a video do something else, like open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.
patches_modified.previous_description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone and pick the language translations come out in.

patches_modified.name: Advanced downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, and save a story from its share sheet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: High Quality Audio Export & Audio Tools - Moises
patches_modified.description: Bypasses client-side audio bitrate export caps (enabling 320kbps MP3 and WAV export options) and unlocks unlimited audio pitch shift, tempo changes, Smart Metronome, and chord detection in Moises (v2.7.2 recommandée).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium & Pro Features - Moises
patches_modified.description: Hooks Google Play BillingClient, RevenueCat EntitlementInfo, and subscription data models in Moises (v2.72.0 recommandée) to unlock client-side Pro features, bypass startup upgrade paywalls, Smart Metronome, chord detection, and pitch/speed controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hooks Google Play BillingClient, RevenueCat EntitlementInfo, and subscription data models in Moises (v2.7.2 recommandée) to unlock client-side Pro features, bypass startup upgrade paywalls, Smart Metronome, chord detection, and pitch/speed controls.

patches_added.name: Speed cameras
patches_added.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server.

patches_added.name: Speeding chime
patches_added.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet.

patches_modified.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder
patches_modified.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate
patches_modified.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes
patches_modified.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag
patches_modified.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Import/Export login token
patches_modified.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches_modified.name: Legacy share links
patches_modified.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches_modified.name: Native downloader
patches_modified.description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.

patches_modified.name: Native reader mode
patches_modified.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches_modified.name: Native translator
patches_modified.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches_modified.name: Remove premium upsell
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches_modified.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches_modified.name: Show poll results
patches_modified.description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.

patches_modified.name: Show sensitive media
patches_modified.description: Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.

patches_modified.name: Support external downloader

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium checks

patches_modified.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag

patches_modified.name: Legacy share links

patches_modified.name: Native translator

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches_modified.name: Remove premium upsell

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches_modified.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches_modified.name: Show poll results

Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, hide Related groups under group posts, and hide comments with shop links or your words. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments.

patches_added.name: Allow screenshots
patches_added.description: Removes the FLAG_SECURE restriction that makes screenshots and screen recordings of the app come out black. The in-app WebView (WavesActivity) stops applying it, and the bundled no_screenshot plugin's own FLAG_SECURE hook is neutered so no screen can re-apply it.

patches_added.name: Hide screenshot detection
patches_added.description: Stops the bundled no_screenshot plugin from registering its MediaStore ContentObserver, so screenshot and screen-recording detection never becomes active and no detection event is delivered to the app's Flutter layer.

patches_modified.name: Adda247 Ad Removal
patches_modified.description: Blocks all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, native, app open and Ad Manager) by neutralizing the Flutter Google Mobile Ads plugin: no ad is ever requested and no ad can ever be shown.

patches_modified.name: Adda247 MoEngage In-App Blocker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the app's own MoEngage in-app promotions (the recurring "recommended for you" nudge with no close button, and full-screen standard in-app messages) by no-oping MoEngage's HTML render chokepoint, so no in-app WebView is ever built or attached. Separate from the Google AdMob block.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Instant Rewarded Ads
patches_modified.description: Watch-ad offers grant their reward instantly with no ad. Forced interstitials stay gone.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes forced ads. No more ads between levels, no banners.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Unlimited Currency
patches_modified.description: Never run out of coins, gems or other resources. Buying things never lowers your balance. Note: ignore the coins/diamonds value shown — even if it shows less than the item price, just tap the item and it will be granted.
